Power BI Sales Analysis Dashboard

 Project Overview

This project uses Microsoft Power BI to analyze sales performance and present business information through an interactive dashboard.

The goal is to transform sales data into meaningful insights that can help stakeholders understand revenue performance, compare sales categories, and identify patterns in the data.

 Business Objectives

* Analyze overall sales performance.
* Examine revenue across different markets.
* Compare revenue generated by product models and stores.
* Explore sales performance across different day categories.
* Use interactive filters to explore the data.
* Present key performance indicators (KPIs) in a visual dashboard.

 Tools Used

 Microsoft Power BI— dashboard development and data visualization.

Add Excel,
Power Query, 
DAX 

 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The dashboard includes the following metrics:

* Total Revenue
* Total Units Sold
* Average Units Sold
* Count of Line of Business (LOB)

These KPIs provide a high-level overview of sales performance.

 Dashboard Preview

![Power BI Sales Analysis Dashboard](power-bi-sales-dashboard.png)

 Dashboard Features

* Revenue analysis by market.
* Revenue comparison by product model.
* Revenue analysis by store.
* Revenue comparison by day category.
* Interactive filters for Line of Business and Trade Date.

Key Findings

The dashboard allows users to explore differences in revenue across markets, product models, stores, and day categories.

* Overall Revenue: Report the total revenue displayed by the dashboard.
* Market Performance: Identify the market with the highest revenue.
* Product Performance:Identify the product model generating the highest revenue.
* Store Performance: Identify the store with the highest revenue.
* Day Category: Compare revenue across the day categories shown.

 Conclusion

This project demonstrates my ability to present sales data in an interactive Power BI dashboard and organize business metrics for easier analysis.

It is part of my ongoing development as an aspiring data analyst, with a focus on data visualization, business insights, and data-driven decision-making.
